data.one_liner: Sentry SDK for Flutter to capture errors, crashes and performance data across platforms.
data.what_it_does: Provides automatic error and exception reporting for Flutter apps, including native crashes on Android and iOS. It also supports performance tracing, navigation monitoring, and experimental session replay on web.
use_when: You need crash reporting and error aggregation for a Flutter app
You want performance monitoring and breadcrumb tracking
You require native crash capture on Android/iOS
You plan to use Sentry’s session replay features
avoid_when: You prefer a self‑hosted or different analytics backend
Bundle size must be minimal and you don’t need crash reporting
You are not using Sentry as a service
strengths: Full‑stack error and crash capture (Dart + native)
Supports Android, iOS, web, macOS, Windows, Linux
weaknesses: Adds native SDK dependencies and increases app size
Tied to Sentry service; not a generic logger
data.setup_notes: Add DSN in SentryFlutter.init, configure native SDKs (Swift Package Manager for iOS/macOS, Gradle for Android), optionally add permissions for network access.

alternatives.name: sentry
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides core Sentry Dart SDK without Flutter‑specific integrations, useful if you only need Dart‑level reporting
